newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bonds, futures weak but spread vs Bund narrow.
newsitem.headline: Italy bonds, futures weak but spread vs Bund narrow.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Italian debt markets remain weak by midsession, pulled down by Bunds despite underlying positive current in Btps, although some near term disappointment Bank of Italy did not cut rates after preliminary May CPI. Dealers note despite Btp market fall, spread with Germany remains at historic low. Prime Minister Prodi optimistic on Italy's EMU chances and economic recovery, and says conditions in place for rate cut.
* Bonds:Feb07 -26bps at 97.34, yield 7.25 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 136 bps.
* Futures:Jun LIF -40 bps at 130.05, sup 129.80, res 130.50.
* Lira:983.50/3.70 per mark, unchanged on morning levels.
